# NBAPI 1.5.3

## Trusted proxy control

- Added a runtime trusted-proxy switch under System Settings > Security > Trusted Proxies.
- Kept the switch enabled by default so upgrades preserve the existing Cloudflare-aware behavior.
- When disabled, NBAPI immediately ignores forwarded client IP headers and uses only the direct TCP peer address without requiring a restart.
- Unified access logs, usage logs, audits, login sessions, IP rate limits, token IP restrictions, Turnstile, and payment risk logging on the same client IP resolver.
- Kept `TRUSTED_PROXIES` as the proxy IP/CIDR allowlist when the web switch is enabled.

## Validation

- Added regression tests for enabled, disabled, and IPv6 direct-address handling.
